function pair<T>(first: T, second: T) {
  return [first, second];
}
function numeric<T extends number>(first: T, second: T) {
  return first + second;
}
pair.apply(null, [1]);
pair.apply(null, [1, 2, 3]);
numeric.apply(null, [1, 'a']);
pair.call(null, 1, 'a');
const explicit: [number, string] = [1, 'a'];
pair.apply(null, explicit);
const direct: (first: number, second: string) => unknown[] = pair;
const wrongResult: number[] = pair.apply(null, [1, 'a']);

const receiver = { n: 2 };
function identity<Item>(this: Item, value: Item) {
  return this;
}
identity.call(receiver, { n: 'wrong' });
const result: { n: number } = identity.call(receiver, { n: 3 });
function constrained<Item extends { n: number }>(this: Item, values: Item[]) {
  return values;
}
constrained.apply(receiver, [[{ n: 'wrong' }]]);
